meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把代码任务交给它,它会先拆成多个小的 PR(合并请求),各自在独立目录里开发,没有依赖的还能并行推进;每个 PR 要在真实环境试跑并留下证据,再开出英文评审链接。自动检查全部通过后自动合入,并清理临时目录。
howto.when: 当代码改动要以 PR(合并请求)形式交付时触发,例如你说“create a PR”“implement issue #42”“把它做成 PR 合入”等;哪怕只说“实现 X”,只要语境明显是想走 PR,也会启动。

say.text: 把 issue #42 实现成一个 PR,按流程处理。
say.note: 会先拆小 PR、开独立目录,验证后再逐个合并。

say.text: 把这批改动拆成尽量小、能独立合入的多个 PR。
say.note: 没有依赖的 PR 会并行开发。

say.text: 实现 X 并做成 PR,检查通过就自动合入。
say.note: 检查全过才合并;审核机器人配额耗尽时允许跳过。

howto.what_en: Splits a coding task into small atomic PRs, one worktree each, parallel for independent ones; requires evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, reruns CI & Cubic until every active gate passes (Cubic skipped only on empty quota), merges, then removes the worktrees.
howto.when_en: When code work should be delivered as a PR — e.g. “create a PR”, “implement issue #42” or “split this into atomic PRs” — or when you only say “implement X” but the context clearly implies a PR.

say_en.note: Runs the full flow: split, QA evidence, PR, checks, merge.

say_en.text: Split this work into small, independently mergeable PRs.
say_en.note: Independent PRs move forward in parallel.

say_en.text: Implement X as a PR and merge once checks pass.
say_en.note: Merge waits for CI and Cubic to pass; Cubic may be skipped on empty quota.
